title.zh: 更換冷氣濾網
title.en: Replace the Cabin Filter

intro.zh: 不用頂車、不用放任何液體。重點是拆飾蓋時不要弄斷卡扣，以及新濾網的氣流箭頭方向。
intro.en: No lifting, no fluids. The skill is removing the cover without snapping clips and fitting the new element with the airflow arrow the right way.

title.zh: 雨刷設到維修位置並立起來
title.en: Put the wipers in the service position and lift them

note.zh: 進入方式依年份不同，查車主手冊。
note.en: How to enter it varies by year; see the owner manual.

title.zh: 拆進氣飾蓋，取出舊濾網
title.en: Remove the cowl cover and lift out the old filter

warning.zh: 塑膠卡扣容易斷，用撬棒從根部撬。
warning.en: The plastic clips break easily; pry from the base.

title.zh: 清掉進氣口的落葉，看舊濾網髒的那一面
title.en: Clear leaves from the intake and look at the dirty face

title.zh: 裝新濾網（照箭頭方向），蓋回飾蓋
title.en: Fit the new filter (arrow the right way) and refit the cover

title.zh: 歸零 CBS 的冷氣濾網提醒
title.en: Reset the cabin-filter CBS reminder

title.zh: 檢查點火線圈（考爾）
title.en: Inspect the Ignition Coils

intro.zh: 考爾沒有固定更換週期，通常換火星塞時一起檢查。學會「對調法」：把懷疑的考爾和隔壁缸對調，看失火故障碼會不會跟著跑。
intro.en: Coils have no fixed interval; check them whenever the plugs come out. Learn the swap test: move the suspect coil to another cylinder and see if the misfire code follows it.

title.zh: 拆引擎飾蓋
title.en: Remove the engine cover

title.zh: 拔插頭、鬆螺絲，取出考爾
title.en: Unplug, unbolt and lift out the coils

title.zh: 看橡膠套有沒有裂、有沒有燒焦痕跡或油
title.en: Check the boots for cracks, burn tracks or oil

note.zh: 橡膠套上有油，通常是氣門室蓋墊片漏油。
note.en: Oil on a boot usually means a leaking valve-cover gasket.

title.zh: 裝回考爾（照缸號），插頭插到聽到「喀」
title.en: Refit the coils in cylinder order; push the plugs home until they click

title.zh: 裝回飾蓋
title.en: Refit the engine cover

title.zh: 檢查冷卻液
title.en: Check the Coolant

intro.zh: 只做檢查與補充。整套換水需要抽真空加注或照程序排氣，電子水泵還要用診斷電腦跑排氣程式，新手先不要做。
intro.en: Check and top up only. A full change needs vacuum filling or a bleed procedure, and the electric pump needs a bleed routine run from a diagnostic tool; leave that for later.

title.zh: 引擎完全冷卻才開副水箱蓋
title.en: Open the expansion tank only when the engine is fully cold

warning.zh: 熱車開蓋，滾燙的冷卻液會噴出來。
warning.en: Opening it hot sprays scalding coolant.

title.zh: 看副水箱浮標或刻度，顏色是否正常、有沒有油花
title.en: Check the float or marks, the colour, and look for oil film

note.zh: 冷卻液裡有油花，可能是機油冷卻器或缸床墊片的問題。
note.en: Oil in the coolant can mean an oil-cooler or head-gasket problem.

title.zh: 沿著冷卻水管看接頭有沒有白色結晶（漏水痕跡）
title.en: Follow the hoses and look for white crust at the joints (leak marks)

title.zh: 要補就補同規格冷卻液，不要只加自來水
title.en: Top up with the same coolant type, not plain tap water

note.zh: 冷卻液規格待查證，照原廠或車主手冊。
note.en: Coolant specification unverified; follow BMW or the owner manual.

title.zh: 更換煞車油
title.en: Brake Fluid Change

intro.zh: 煞車油會吸水，沸點下降，重煞時可能變軟。換油的原則：從離總泵最遠的輪子開始，壺裡的油不能抽乾，不然空氣跑進 ABS 要用診斷電腦排。
intro.en: Brake fluid absorbs water and its boiling point drops, so the pedal can go soft under hard braking. Start at the wheel furthest from the master cylinder and never let the reservoir run dry, or air gets into the ABS unit and needs a diagnostic bleed.

title.zh: 頂車架好，拆四個輪子（或從輪框孔洞接到排氣螺絲）
title.en: Lift and support the car; remove the wheels (or reach the bleed screws through the rims)

title.zh: 拆右後輪
title.en: Remove the right rear wheel

title.zh: 總泵油壺抽掉舊油，加新油
title.en: Suck old fluid out of the reservoir and fill with new

note.zh: 煞車油規格待查證（DOT 等級照原廠）。
note.en: Fluid specification unverified (use the BMW DOT grade).

title.zh: 依序右後 → 左後 → 右前 → 左前，排到流出清澈新油
title.en: Bleed right rear, left rear, right front, left front until clean fluid runs

note.zh: 順序是「離總泵最遠的先」。左駕車總泵在左邊，所以右後最遠。
note.en: Furthest from the master cylinder first; on a left-hand-drive car that is the right rear.

warning.zh: 煞車油會咬漆，滴到車身立刻用水沖。
warning.en: Brake fluid strips paint; rinse any drips with water at once.

title.zh: 裝回輪子，對角鎖扭力
title.en: Refit the wheel and torque in a star pattern

title.zh: 踩煞車確認踏板硬、沒有往下沉，再試車
title.en: Check the pedal is firm and does not sink before driving

title.zh: 自排變速箱換油（ATF）
title.en: Automatic Transmission Fluid Service

intro.zh: 8HP 的濾網和油底殼是一體的，換油就是換整個油底殼。最關鍵的是油位：要在油溫約 40–50 °C、引擎運轉時，從加油孔補到溢出為止。
intro.en: On the 8HP the filter is part of the pan, so a fluid service means a new pan. The critical part is the level: fill at about 40–50 °C with the engine running until it spills from the fill hole.

title.zh: 車要水平頂起（四輪都架高），不然油位會錯
title.en: Lift the car level (all four corners) or the level reading will be wrong

title.zh: 先確認加油孔螺絲鬆得開，再放油
title.en: Make sure the fill plug comes undone before draining

warning.zh: 放了油卻打不開加油孔，車就動不了了。
warning.en: Drain it and find the fill plug seized, and the car is stranded.

title.zh: 放油，拆油底殼（含濾網）
title.en: Drain and remove the pan (with integrated filter)

title.zh: 裝新油底殼
title.en: Fit the new pan

note.zh: 油底殼螺絲扭力待查證。

title.zh: 加油到溢出，發動、各檔停一下，油溫 40–50 °C 時再補到溢出
title.en: Fill until it spills, start, pause in each gear, then top up to spilling at 40–50 °C

note.zh: 油溫要用診斷電腦讀。ATF 規格待查證，照原廠。
note.en: Read the fluid temperature with a diagnostic tool. ATF specification unverified; use BMW/ZF fluid.

title.zh: 更換差速器油
title.en: Rear Differential Oil Change

intro.zh: 跟變速箱一樣的鐵則：先鬆加油孔，確定打得開，再鬆放油孔。
intro.en: Same golden rule as any gearbox: undo the fill plug first and only then the drain plug.

title.zh: 車水平頂起架好
title.en: Lift the car level and support it

title.zh: 先鬆加油孔螺絲
title.en: Undo the fill plug first

title.zh: 鬆放油孔，放完舊油，看螺絲上的磁鐵有多少鐵粉
title.en: Undo the drain plug, drain, and check the magnet for metal paste

note.zh: 一點灰色鐵泥正常；有碎片代表齒輪或軸承有問題。
note.en: A little grey paste is normal; chunks mean gear or bearing damage.

title.zh: 鎖回放油孔（新墊片），從加油孔加到剛好流出
title.en: Refit the drain plug (new washer) and fill until it just runs out of the fill hole

note.zh: 差速器油規格與用量待查證。
note.en: Diff oil specification and capacity unverified.

title.zh: 鎖回加油孔
title.en: Refit the fill plug

title.zh: 更換附件皮帶
title.en: Replace the Accessory Belt

intro.zh: 拆之前先拍照或畫下皮帶繞法。張緊器用扳手往一個方向轉就會鬆開。
intro.en: Photograph or sketch the belt routing first. Turning the tensioner one way with a wrench releases the belt.

title.zh: 拍下皮帶繞法
title.en: Photograph the belt routing

title.zh: 轉開張緊器，取下皮帶
title.en: Turn the tensioner and slip the belt off

warning.zh: 張緊器彈簧很強，放回時慢慢放，不要讓它彈回去。
warning.en: The tensioner spring is strong; let it back slowly, never let it snap.

title.zh: 轉一轉張緊器輪與惰輪：有沙沙聲或晃動就一起換
title.en: Spin the tensioner and idler: if they rumble or wobble, replace them too

title.zh: 照照片繞好新皮帶，放回張緊器
title.en: Route the new belt per the photo and release the tensioner

title.zh: 發動，看皮帶有沒有跑偏、有沒有尖叫聲
title.en: Start the engine; check the belt tracks straight and does not squeal

title.zh: 更換雨刷片
title.en: Replace the Wiper Blades

intro.zh: 最簡單的保養。注意尺寸（左右可能不同）與接頭型式。
intro.en: The easiest job of all. Check the sizes (left and right can differ) and the connector type.

title.zh: 雨刷設到維修位置
title.en: Put the wipers in the service position

title.zh: 立起刷臂，按卡榫取下舊刷片
title.en: Lift the arm and release the old blade

title.zh: 裝上新刷片，聽到卡住聲，輕輕放回玻璃
title.en: Click the new blade on and lay the arm back gently

title.zh: 噴水試刷，看有沒有水痕
title.en: Spray and wipe; look for streaks

title.zh: 輪胎換位與胎壓
title.en: Tyre Rotation & Pressures

intro.zh: 換位前先確認：前後尺寸一樣才能前後換；不一樣只能左右換（而且是無方向性胎才行）。胎壓照駕駛側門框標籤，冷胎時量。
intro.en: Check first: front-to-rear only if all four are the same size; staggered sizes can only swap side to side (non-directional tyres only). Set pressures from the driver door-jamb label, cold.

title.zh: 先鬆四輪螺絲，再頂車架好
title.en: Crack all wheel bolts, then lift and support the car

title.zh: 拆左前輪
title.en: Remove the left front wheel

title.zh: 拆左後輪
title.en: Remove the left rear wheel

title.zh: 看胎紋深度和磨耗形狀（內側磨、外側磨、中間磨）
title.en: Check tread depth and wear pattern (inner, outer or centre wear)

note.zh: 單邊磨通常是定位問題，換位只是延後。
note.en: One-sided wear is usually alignment; rotation only postpones it.

title.zh: 前後對調裝回（左前 ↔ 左後）
title.en: Refit swapped front-to-rear (left front ↔ left rear)

title.zh: 裝回另一顆，放下車對角鎖扭力
title.en: Refit the other, lower the car and torque in a star pattern

title.zh: 照門框標籤調胎壓，iDrive 重設胎壓監測
title.en: Set pressures to the door label and reset the tyre-pressure monitor in iDrive

note.zh: 胎壓數值以車上標籤為準，本工具不提供數字（待查證）。
note.en: Use the label on the car; this tool gives no figure (unverified).
